items.q: Which statement correctly defines Contour?
o: the direction from which wind most often comes
a nearby origin of unwanted sound that shapes layout
the share of the plot the building may cover
a line on a drawing joining points of equal height
items.s: Contour: a line on a drawing joining points of equal height. The other options describe Prevailing wind, Noise source, Coverage.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Design intent.
o: the record of sketches and thinking kept through a project
the arranged sheet on which a scheme is shown
the stated idea a scheme sets out to achieve
the repeated remaking of a scheme as understanding grows
items.s: Design intent: the stated idea a scheme sets out to achieve. The other options describe Presentation board, Iteration in design, Design journal.

items.q: The correct meaning of Anthropometrics is
o: the measurement of the dimensions of the human body
the study of fitting work and objects to the human body
the width of path a person or group needs to pass
the space a standing person can comfortably reach into
items.s: Anthropometrics: the measurement of the dimensions of the human body. The other options describe Circulation width, Reach envelope, Ergonomics.

items.q: “the study of a plot's conditions before designing on it” is the definition of
o: Site analysis
Vegetation
Drainage
Orientation
items.s: Site analysis is the study of a plot's conditions before designing on it.

items.q: The correct meaning of Unity is
o: the lines to which elements are set so the design reads as ordered
the arrangement of parts into a satisfying whole
the quality of a design reading as one thing
the differences that keep a composition from dullness
items.s: Unity: the quality of a design reading as one thing. The other options describe Composition, Datums and alignment, Variety.

items.q: In this course, Anthropometrics refers to
o: the study of fitting work and objects to the human body
the range of conditions in which a person feels at ease
the measurement of the dimensions of the human body
the line of view a seated or standing person needs
items.s: Anthropometrics: the measurement of the dimensions of the human body. The other options describe Ergonomics, Comfort zone, Sightline.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Insulation.
o: the planned removal of rain from roofs and ground
the use of overhangs, screens and planting against sun
the heat a building takes from the sun
the material that slows the passage of heat
items.s: Insulation: the material that slows the passage of heat. The other options describe Solar gain, Rainwater disposal, Shading.
